title: LuckyQworms 20lb Dried Mealworms

comparisons.notes: LuckyQworms dried mealworms, 20 lb variant, SKU LQ_20, available in the brand store's live catalog.

writeup: Woot has the 20 lb bag of LuckyQworms dried mealworms, new, for $49.99. The brand's own Petfu store charges $115.99 for the same 20 lb bag, so this is about 56% less. The mealworms carry a guaranteed 52% minimum crude protein and come in a resealable bag, a good bulk buy for chicken keepers. Woot showed very few left.
amazon_match_notes: Checker verified exact ASIN B088H71V9N (model LUCKYQ20LB-1N, MPN LUCKYQ20LB-N).
